targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM reporting.sm_monitors m WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer)))

SELECT ROUND(AVG(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo()))),3) AS avail FROM reporting.sm_monitors m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer)))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS below FROM (SELECT 100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())) AS avail FROM reporting.sm_monitors m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer)))) t WHERE t.avail < $availTarget

SELECT CASE WHEN 100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())) >= $availTarget THEN 'Meets' ELSE 'Below Target' END AS `Status`, m.monName AS `Service Name`, ROUND(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())),3) AS `Percentage Available`, ROUND(100*COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo()),3) AS `Percentage Down`, COALESCE(o.outages,0) AS `Outage Count` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.monOutageID) AS outages, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) ORDER BY `Percentage Available` ASC, `Service Name`

SELECT CASE WHEN 100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())) >= $availTarget THEN 'Meets' ELSE 'Below Target' END AS `Status`, cm.custName AS `Customer`, m.monName AS `Service Name`, ROUND(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())),3) AS `Percentage Available`, ROUND(100*COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo()),3) AS `Percentage Down`, COALESCE(o.outages,0) AS `Outage Count` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN reporting.sm_slmuses su ON su.monitorMH=m.monitorMH AND su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL JOIN reporting.sm_customermhs cm ON cm.customerMH=su.customerMH AND cm.customerMH NOT IN (0,1) AND cm.custDestroyTime IS NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.monOutageID) AS outages, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR su.customerMH IN ($customer)) ORDER BY `Customer`, `Percentage Available` ASC

SELECT CONCAT(CASE WHEN m.monitorType=0 THEN '(S) ' ELSE '' END, m.monName) AS `Service Or Resource Monitor`, r.resourceName AS `Resources`, r.resourceModelClass AS `Resource Class` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN reporting.sm_slmmonitors smm ON m.monitorMH=smm.monitorMH AND smm.monitorsDestroyTime IS NULL JOIN reporting.sm_resources r ON smm.resourceMH=r.resourceMH WHERE m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) ORDER BY m.monName, r.resourceName
